title: One simulated member turn
description: What the member says and does in one turn. Field meanings: docs/members/study/roles/actor.md.

as_member.description: One line in character: 'As <name>, I…' — what you are trying to do right now.

noticed.description: At most 60 words, quoted or paraphrased from what is on the screen.

candidates.description: Two or three things on the screen you might use next.

expect.description: Before acting: what you think will happen, and where on the screen you will see it.

last_expectation.description: Did your previous expectation hold? On your first turn: verdict match, note 'first turn'.

action.description: Exactly one action. tap/hover: x, y in screenshot pixels. scroll: dir + screens (0.5 or 1). type: text. key: Enter or Escape. done: answer. give_up: why.
